resolutionsNotes._: Forces patched versions of nested dependencies flagged by `yarn audit` that the latest Docusaurus / swagger-ui-react releases have not picked up yet. Remove an entry once its parent depends on a patched version, then run yarn install, yarn audit and yarn build. Yarn-only: npm ignores `resolutions`.
resolutionsNotes.**/tinypool: Critical prototype-pollution-to-RCE advisories in tinypool <2.1.2. Pulled in by @docusaurus/core (SSG worker threads), which still requests ^1.0.2.
resolutionsNotes.**/serialize-javascript: High RCE, moderate DoS and low XSS advisories in serialize-javascript <7.1.3. Pulled in by copy-webpack-plugin and css-minimizer-webpack-plugin, which still request ^6.
resolutionsNotes.**/uuid: Moderate buffer bounds-check advisory in uuid <11.1.1. Pulled in by sockjs (webpack dev server only), which still requests ^8.3.2.
resolutionsNotes.**/@swagger-api/apidom-reference/minimat: Moderate DoS advisory in minimatch 7.x-11.0.0. Pulled in by swagger-ui-react via @swagger-api/apidom-reference. Scoped on purpose: serve-handler (yarn serve) pins minimatch 3.1.5, which has an incompatible API.
